principles: Follow the locked pre-registration (spend match, not call count)
Capture spend at the source (claude JSON usage), accumulate per run
Match pre-reg section 7 field names exactly
Do not regress existing arm semantics

options.name: spend-budget-truncation
pros: Matches pre-reg exactly (token+wall-clock, plus-or-minus 20 percent, hard-truncate)
cons: Must capture tokens + add a budget loop mode

options.name: call-count-budget
cons: CONTRADICTS the locked pre-reg (not call count); reintroduces the compute confound

options.name: cost-usd-only-budget
cons: Pre-reg names tokens+wall-clock; cost is a proxy; record tokens to match the spec

rationale: The locked pre-registration defines A2-prime as token+wall-clock spend match with plus-or-minus 20 percent and hard-truncation; implementing exactly that keeps the A4 vs A2-prime comparison free of the compute confound, which call-count would reintroduce.

preMortem.trigger: claude JSON usage shape differs / not read
preMortem.mitigation: Read usage tokens from the claude -p JSON (already parsed for cost); record tokensSpent; if usage absent, fall back to cost-derived note and flag

preMortem.trigger: a2prime stops at acceptance pass before budget reached
preMortem.mitigation: Record actual tokensSpent + budgetPass so any under-match is visible and bounded by the tolerance band (logged)
Use the exact pre-reg section 7 names: tokensSpent, wallClockMs, agentCallCount
